definition_zh: 指数；幂；上标数字；阐述者；倡导者；典型代表
definition_en: the power to which a number is raised, or a person who sets out and defends an idea
core_image: 一个数字被抬到另一个数字的右上角，像站在肩膀上
scene: 墙上的公式里，一个数字被抬到字母的右上角，表示连乘的次数。 In the formula, the exponent tells how many times the base is used as a factor.
sceneCN: 这里 exponent 指「幂指数，即底数连乘的次数」（第 1 个义项：指数）；句意为公式里的指数说明底数被当作因子用了几次。图中可辨识物件：公式、抬高的数字、粉笔、墙面。

pos.zh: 指数；幂；上标数字；阐述者；倡导者；典型

derivatives.zh: 详述；阐述（同出拉丁 exponere）
使暴露；揭露（同出拉丁 exponere）

senses.title: The power a number is raised to
senses.definition: the number that says how many times a base is multiplied by itself
senses.definitionCN: 说明底数自乘多少次的数
senses.example: In the formula, the exponent tells how many times the base is used as a factor.
senses.exampleCN: 在公式里，指数说明底数被当作因子用了几次。
senses.why: exponere means 'to set out'; the exponent sets out how many repetitions the base undergoes.
senses.whyCN: exponere 意为「摆出来」；指数就是把底数重复多少次「摆出来」。

senses.title: The raised figure in notation
senses.definition: the small figure written above and to the right of a base
senses.definitionCN: 写在底数右上方的小数字
senses.example: A raised exponent beside the letter marks repeated multiplication.
senses.exampleCN: 字母旁边抬高的指数标出重复相乘。
senses.why: the written position is the visual form of the mathematical idea: the number is literally lifted above the base.
senses.whyCN: 书写位置正是数学想法的可视化：这个数确实被抬到底数上方。

senses.title: A person who explains
senses.definition: someone who sets out and explains a subject in detail
senses.definitionCN: 把某个主题详细摆出来并加以解释的人
senses.example: He became the clearest exponent of the new method in his department.
senses.exampleCN: 他成了本部门里把这种新方法讲得最清楚的人。
senses.why: the Latin participle meant 'setting forth', and a person who sets a subject forth is an expounder.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁分词意为「摆出来」，把主题摆出来的人就是阐述者。

senses.title: A spokesman for a cause
senses.definition: a person who speaks publicly in support of an idea or movement
senses.definitionCN: 公开为某种理念或运动说话的人
senses.example: She was the leading exponent of the reform movement.
senses.exampleCN: 她是这场改革运动的主要代表人物。
senses.why: from explaining a subject it is a short step to speaking for it, so exponent took on the role of public advocate.
senses.whyCN: 从解释一个主题到为它说话只差一步，于是 exponent 承担起公开倡导者的角色。

senses.title: A typical example
senses.definition: a person or thing that shows what a class or style is like
senses.definitionCN: 能显示某一类别或风格是什么样的人或物
senses.example: The little chapel is a fine exponent of the local stone style.
senses.exampleCN: 这座小礼拜堂是当地石构风格的一个很好例证。
senses.why: a thing that sets forth a style is itself the showing of that style, hence 'a typical example'.
senses.whyCN: 把一种风格摆出来的东西，本身就是那种风格的展示，因此引申为「典型例证」。

senses.title: The exponent of a group
senses.definition: the smallest positive power that sends every element of a group to the identity
senses.definitionCN: 使群中每个元素都化为单位元的最小正整数次幂
senses.example: The exponent of the group divides the order of the group.
senses.exampleCN: 这个群的指数整除群的阶。
senses.why: group theory reuses the arithmetic word for the power that makes every element collapse to the identity.
senses.whyCN: 群论把这个算术词挪用来指那个让每个元素都塌回单位元的幂。

senses.title: The exponent of a prime in a factorization
senses.definition: the number showing how many times a prime factor occurs in an integer
senses.definitionCN: 表示某个素因子在一个整数里出现几次的数
senses.example: The exponent of two in twelve is two.
senses.exampleCN: 在十二里，因子二的指数是二。
senses.why: factorization counts repetitions, and the exponent is exactly the written count of those repetitions.
senses.whyCN: 分解数的是重复次数，而指数正是这些重复次数被写下来的结果。

senses.title: A unit that realizes a linguistic feature
senses.definition: a sound or form that carries a particular grammatical feature
senses.definitionCN: 承载某一语法特征的具体语音或形式
senses.example: The past-tense ending is the exponent of tense in that verb.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个动词里，过去时词尾是时态的体现形式。
senses.why: linguistics borrows the 'setting forth' idea: a form sets forth an abstract feature in audible shape.
senses.whyCN: 语言学借用了「摆出来」的想法：某个形式把抽象特征以可听见的形态摆出来。

senses.title: The exponent in scientific notation
senses.definition: the power of ten that scales a number in scientific notation
senses.definitionCN: 科学记数法中用来缩放数值的十的幂
senses.example: Changing the exponent moved the decimal point six places.
senses.exampleCN: 改变指数把小数点移动了六位。
senses.why: in scientific notation the exponent is the part that records how far the decimal point has been shifted.
senses.whyCN: 在科学记数法里，指数就是记录小数点被移动了多远的那个部分。

intro.en: Exponent comes from Latin exponens, the present participle of exponere 'to put out, set forth, explain', built on ex- 'out' and ponere 'to put, place'. The mathematical sense was added in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: exponent 来自拉丁 exponens，即 exponere「摆出来、陈述、解释」的现在分词，由 ex-「出」与 ponere「放、置」构成。数学义是十七世纪才加上的。

items.en: Ponere meant 'to put, place, set'. It is one of the most productive Latin verbs in English compounds: component, postpone, compose and deposit all descend from it.
items.cn: ponere 意为「放、置、摆」。它是英语复合词中最能产的拉丁动词之一：component、postpone、compose 与 deposit 都出自它。

items.en: Ex- 'out' plus ponere gave exponere 'to put out, set forth, expose, explain'. The same verb produced both expose and expound in English.
items.cn: ex-「出」加 ponere 构成 exponere「摆出来、陈述、暴露、解释」。同一个动词在英语里既产生 expose，也产生 expound。

items.en: The present participle exponens named one who sets something forth, hence an expounder or interpreter.
items.cn: 现在分词 exponens 指把某事物摆出来的人，因此是阐述者、解释者。

items.en: English took exponent first as a noun for a person who explains or interprets a text or doctrine.
items.cn: 英语最初把 exponent 用作名词，指解释或诠释文本、教义的人。

items.en: In the seventeenth century the word was applied to the raised number that shows a power, since it 'sets forth' how many times the base is repeated.
items.cn: 十七世纪时，这个词被用来指右上角表示幂的数，因为它把底数重复了多少次「摆出来」。

items.en: The exact first mathematical citation is approximate; the Latin verb itself and its participle are securely attested.
items.cn: 数学义的最早确切书证年代为约数；但这个拉丁动词及其分词本身有可靠记录。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin verb ponere 'to put' and is a constant source of confusion; the second group names people or numbers with a comparable role.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁动词 ponere「放」，是持续不断的混淆来源；第二组是角色相近的人或数。

entries.definition: Com- 'together' plus ponere: a part put together with others into a whole; it is not an exponent.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「共同」的前缀加 ponere：与其他部分拼成整体的一个部件；并非指数。

entries.definition: Post- 'after' plus ponere: to put something off to a later time.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「之后」的前缀加 ponere：把事情放到更晚的时间。

entries.definition: Also from exponere, but through French: to put something out where it can be seen, hence to uncover.
entries.definitionCN: 同样出自 exponere，但经法语而来：把东西摆到能被看见的地方，因此指揭露、暴露。

entries.definition: From exponere through Old French: to set out an idea at length; it is the verb behind the 'explainer' sense of exponent.
entries.definitionCN: 出自 exponere，经古法语而来：详细陈述一个想法；它正是 exponent「阐述者」义背后的动词。

entries.definition: Ob- 'against' plus ponere: one who sets himself against another, not one who sets a subject forth.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「对着」的前缀加 ponere：把自己摆到别人对面的人，而非把主题摆出来的人。

entries.definition: In arithmetic, the result of repeated multiplication or the number of repetitions; it overlaps with exponent but can also mean the result.
entries.definitionCN: 在算术里指重复相乘的结果或次数；与指数重叠，但也常指结果本身。

entries.definition: A synonym for exponent in older mathematical writing; it also means a pointer or a list.
entries.definitionCN: 较老的数学文献里是 exponent 的同义词；它另指指针或索引。

entries.definition: A person who argues publicly for a cause; it matches the 'spokesman' sense without the explanatory tone.
entries.definitionCN: 公开为某项事业辩护的人；对应「代言人」义，但不带解释的色彩。

entries.definition: One who puts a proposal forward; it is built on the same putting verb, ponere.
entries.definitionCN: 提出并支持某项主张的人；同样由那个表示「放」的动词构成。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin pieces, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁构件、真实的同族词与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: ex- 'out' plus ponere 'put': the exponent is the number put out above the base.
normal.cn: ex-「出」加 ponere「放」：指数就是被放到底数上方的那个数。

normal.en: The family runs exponent, exponential, exponentially, exponentiation and expound.
normal.cn: 同族词有 exponent、exponential、exponentially、exponentiation 与 expound。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the two lives of the word: fractional exponent, and chief exponent of a movement.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出这个词的两条命：分数指数，以及某项运动的主要倡导者。

normal.en: The same ponere builds component, postpone and opponent, all about placing something somewhere.
normal.cn: 同一个 ponere 还构成 component、postpone 与 opponent，都是把某物放到某处。

normal.en: In a power, the base carries the weight and the exponent rides on its shoulder.
normal.cn: 在幂里，底数扛着重量，指数骑在它肩上。

abstract.en: Picture a small figure standing on a tall number's shoulder, counting how many times it is copied.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小人站在一个大数的肩膀上，数它被复制了多少次。

abstract.en: Picture a lecturer lifting a heavy idea above the crowd so everyone can see it.
abstract.cn: 想象一位讲演者把一个沉重的想法举过人群头顶，让所有人都看见。

abstract.en: Picture a label on a bottle that tells you how concentrated the contents are.
abstract.cn: 想象瓶子上贴着标签，告诉你里面的东西浓缩到什么程度。

examples.en: A negative exponent turns the base into a fraction.
examples.cn: 负指数会把底数变成一个分数。

examples.en: She became the public exponent of a quieter style of architecture.
examples.cn: 她成了那种更安静的建筑风格的公开倡导者。

examples.en: The exponent on the ten shows how far the decimal point has moved.
examples.cn: 十上面的指数显示小数点移动了多远。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一克斯破能」——把「能」一层层破开叠到右上角 → 指数

root: 拉丁 exponere「摆出来、陈述」= ex-（出）+ ponere（放、置）→ exponens「摆出来的人／摆出来的东西」。英语 exponent，数学义十七世纪起。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses split between two gestures: a number lifted above a base, and a person who lifts an idea into public view. Both come from the same Latin verb for setting something out.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项分成两个动作：一个数被抬到底数上方，一个人把一个想法抬到公众眼前。两者都出自同一个表示「摆出来」的拉丁动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one number standing on the shoulder of another, counting repetitions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个数站在另一个数的肩膀上，数重复的次数。

branches.en: RAISED POWER: the count of repetitions and the small figure written above the base.
branches.cn: 抬高的幂：重复的次数，以及写在底数上方的小数字。

branches.en: PERSON WHO EXPLAINS: one who sets a subject out in detail.
branches.cn: 解释的人：把主题详细摆出来的人。

branches.en: SPEAKING SAMPLE: the advocate speaks for a movement, and the little chapel speaks for a style.
branches.cn: 会说话的样本：倡导者为运动说话，小礼拜堂为一种风格说话。

branches.en: COUNTING POWER: group theory and prime factorization both use the raised number as a tally.
branches.cn: 计数的幂：群论与素因子分解都把那个抬高的数当作计数。

branches.en: REALIZED FORM: a suffix carries an abstract feature, and a power of ten carries a shifted decimal point.
branches.cn: 体现出来的形式：词尾承载抽象特征，十的幂承载被移动的小数点。

intro.en: Exponent is a Latin participle of a verb built from a prefix and the common verb for placing; the same pieces build many English words.
intro.cn: exponent 是一个拉丁分词，其动词由前缀与那个最常用的「放」动词构成；这些构件还构成许多英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin ponere gives component, postpone, compose, deposit and opponent; ex- adds the sense of putting something out into view.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ponere 衍生 component、postpone、compose、deposit 与 opponent；ex- 增添「把东西摆到可见处」的意思。

items.example: The prefix pulls the idea out where it can be seen.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把想法拉到能被看见的地方。

items.example: The root is the plain act of placing something.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根就是放置东西的朴素动作。

items.meaning: to put out, set forth, explain
items.example: The verb covers both exposing and explaining.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词既包括暴露，也包括解释。

items.meaning: setting forth; one who sets forth
items.example: The participle became both adjective and noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词既作形容词，也作名词。

items.example: The exponent sits above the base.
items.exampleCN: 指数坐在底数上方。

items.example: The curve is exponential in shape.
items.exampleCN: 这条曲线在形状上是指数的。

items.meaning: the operation of raising to a power
items.example: Exponentiation grows faster than multiplication.
items.exampleCN: 求幂比乘法增长得快。

items.meaning: a part placed together with others
items.meaningCN: 与其他部分拼在一起的部件
items.example: Each component was tested alone.
items.exampleCN: 每个部件都单独测试过。

items.example: They postponed the launch by a week.
items.exampleCN: 他们把发射推迟了一周。

latinEntries.meaning: to put out, set forth, explain
setting forth; one who sets forth

derivatives.zh: 详述；阐述（同出拉丁 exponere）
使暴露；揭露（同出拉丁 exponere）

definition_zh: 出口；输出；出口商品
definition_en: to send goods to another country; to spread ideas or skills abroad; goods sold abroad
core_image: 装满货物的集装箱驶向海外港口
scene: 这家公司向欧洲出口机器。 The company exports machines to Europe.
sceneCN: 这里 export 是「出口货物」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家公司向欧洲出口机器。

senses.title: Sell goods abroad
senses.definition: to send goods to another country for sale
senses.definitionCN: 把货物运往另一国家销售
senses.example: The country exports coffee and bananas.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家出口咖啡和香蕉。
senses.why: The core sense is carrying goods out.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把货物运出去。

senses.title: Spread ideas abroad
senses.definition: to spread ideas, skills, or culture to other places
senses.definitionCN: 把思想、技术或文化传播到其他地方
senses.example: The university exports its teaching methods.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学输出自己的教学方法。
senses.why: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
senses.whyCN: 货物被向外传播的思想所取代。

senses.title: Goods sold abroad
senses.definition: goods or services sold to another country
senses.definitionCN: 卖到另一国家的商品或服务
senses.example: Oil is the country's main export.
senses.exampleCN: 石油是这个国家的主要出口商品。
senses.why: The action becomes the thing being sent.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成被运出的东西。

intro.en: Export comes from Latin exportare, to carry out, from ex- out and portare to carry.
intro.cn: export 来自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Portare means to carry.
items.cn: portare 意为搬运。

items.en: Exportare means to carry out.
items.cn: exportare 意为运出去。

items.en: Export names trade that sends goods away.
items.cn: export 指把货物运往外的贸易。

items.en: Export also covers ideas and services.
items.cn: 现代英语中 export 也涵盖思想与服务。

note.en: Export means send out; import means bring in.
note.cn: export 是运出去，import 则是运进来。

entries.definition: to bring goods into a country
a person with special knowledge
to become larger
to send goods somewhere
to carry from one place to another
to give something for money

normalIntro.en: Export is about goods and ideas carried out of a country.
normalIntro.cn: export 指货物与思想被运出一个国家。

normal.en: Brazil exports coffee to many countries.
normal.cn: 巴西向许多国家出口咖啡。

normal.en: The firm exports software to Asia.
normal.cn: 这家公司向亚洲出口软件。

normal.en: Tea was once a major export of China.
normal.cn: 茶叶曾是中国的主要出口商品。

normal.en: New rules made exporting easier.
normal.cn: 新规定让出口变得更容易。

normal.en: The port handles exports every day.
normal.cn: 这个港口每天处理出口货物。

abstract.en: Picture a ship loaded with boxes leaving port.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘装满箱子的船驶离港口。

abstract.en: Imagine a teacher sharing a method with another country.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老师把方法传到另一个国家。

abstract.en: Think of a map with arrows pointing outward.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，箭头全都指向外面。

examples.en: They export wine to Europe and America.
examples.cn: 他们把葡萄酒出口到欧洲和美洲。

examples.en: The country depends on oil exports.
examples.cn: 这个国家依赖石油出口。

examples.en: The company began exporting last year.
examples.cn: 这家公司去年开始出口。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 port（搬运）：把货物搬向国外，就是 export（出口）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，核心义「把货物或观念运出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Export means to sell goods abroad, to spread ideas outward, or goods sold abroad.
sensesIntro.cn: export 意为向国外销售货物、向外传播思想，或出口商品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a container ship heading for a foreign port.
core.cn: 核心意象：驶向海外港口的集装箱船。

branches.en: The base sense is sending goods abroad.
branches.cn: 基础义是把货物运往国外。

branches.en: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
branches.cn: 货物被向外传播的思想取代。

branches.en: The action becomes the goods themselves.
branches.cn: 动作变成货物本身。

branches.en: Trade and cultural spread both move outward.
branches.cn: 贸易与文化传播都向外流动。

branches.en: The act of exporting and the exports themselves are linked.
branches.cn: 出口行为与出口商品相互关联。

intro.en: Export is built on Latin ex- out and portare to carry, the same root as transport.
intro.cn: export 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，与 transport 同根。

latinIntro.en: Latin exportare, portare, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exportare、portare 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.meaning: to send goods abroad or such goods
items.example: They export rice to nearby markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把大米出口到邻近市场。

items.structure: English verb form and plural noun
items.meaningCN: 出口（第三人称）；出口商品
items.example: The country's exports rose sharply.
items.exampleCN: 这个国家的出口大幅上升。

items.example: The exported fruit arrives by sea.
items.exampleCN: 出口的水果经海运输达。

items.example: Exporting requires careful paperwork.
items.exampleCN: 出口需要仔细处理文书。

items.meaning: a person or country that exports
items.example: China is a major exporter of electronics.
items.exampleCN: 中国是电子产品的主要出口国。

items.example: The law controls the exportation of arms.
items.exampleCN: 法律管制武器出口。

items.example: They import steel from abroad.
items.exampleCN: 他们从国外进口钢材。

items.meaning: to carry from place to place
items.example: Trucks transport goods inland.
items.exampleCN: 卡车把货物运往内陆。

items.example: -Port appears in export and import.
items.exampleCN: -port 出现在 export 与 import 中。

definition_zh: 出口商；出口国；报关出口方；导出程序或导出工具
definition_en: a person, firm or country that sells or sends goods out to another country
core_image: 码头尽头一位商人把提单递给船长，身后是已经装好的本国货物，船将驶向海外
scene: 出口码头上，一位商人把提单递给船长，身后的本国货物已经全部装船。 The exporter handed over the bill of lading before the ship left for overseas buyers.
sceneCN: 这里指「把货物卖到境外的出口商」，对应第 1 个义项：向另一国买方售出并运出货物的一方；句意为这位出口商在船离港前把提单交给船长。画面要点：码头、提单、已装船的本国货物、远处的船身。

pos.zh: 出口商；出口方（可数，指公司、个人或国家）

derivatives.zh: 出口（exporter 的基础动词，去掉施动后缀即得，指把货物搬出去）
出口行为（export 加表示动作的名词后缀，指过程而非人）
可出口的（export 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许或能够外销）
多个出口方（exporter 加复数后缀，语义由单方转为多方）
报关出口方（exporter 加 of record 构成的法定称谓，指登记在案的出口责任方）

senses.title: A firm that sells goods abroad
senses.titleCN: 把货物卖到境外的公司
senses.definition: a business that sells and ships its goods to buyers in other countries
senses.definitionCN: 把货物卖给另一国买方并运出的企业
senses.example: The exporter handed over the bill of lading before the ship left for overseas buyers.
senses.exampleCN: 这位出口商在船离港前把提单交给船长。
senses.why: Export is the act of carrying goods out, and the agent suffix names the party performing it, so exporter is 'the one who sends out'.
senses.whyCN: export 是把货物搬出去的动作，施动后缀指执行者，因此 exporter 就是「把货送出去的那一个」。

senses.title: A country that sells more than it buys
senses.titleCN: 出口大于进口的国家或地区
senses.definition: a country or region whose sales abroad exceed its purchases from abroad
senses.definitionCN: 向外售出多于从境外购入的国家或地区
senses.example: The country is a net exporter of copper and a net importer of wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 该国是铜的净出口方、小麦的净进口方。
senses.why: Trade balances are counted at the level of economies, so a whole country can be called a party that exports.
senses.whyCN: 贸易差额在经济体层面计算，于是整个国家也能被称作出口的一方。

senses.title: The party legally responsible at customs
senses.titleCN: 在海关承担法律责任的报关出口方
senses.definition: the party registered as legally responsible for goods leaving the country
senses.definitionCN: 在货物出境时被登记为承担法律责任的一方
senses.example: The exporter of record filed the declaration before loading.
senses.exampleCN: 报关出口方在装船前提交了申报。
senses.why: Each shipment needs one accountable name, so the commercial role hardened into a customs status.
senses.whyCN: 每票货物都需要一个可追责的名字，商业角色于是固化为海关身份。

senses.title: A seller of power or fuel to another grid
senses.titleCN: 向其他电网或市场售电、售燃料的一方
senses.definition: a utility, region or country that sells electricity or fuel beyond its own system
senses.definitionCN: 向本系统之外售出电力或燃料的公用事业、地区或国家
senses.example: The province became a net exporter of electricity after the dams were built.
senses.exampleCN: 水坝建成后，该省成为电力净出口方。
senses.why: Energy flows across grid boundaries like cargo across borders, and the sending side takes the same label.
senses.whyCN: 能源像货物过境一样跨过电网边界，送出的一端得到同样的称呼。

senses.title: A tool that writes data out
senses.titleCN: 把数据写出去的导出程序
senses.definition: a routine or feature that saves data from an application in an outside format
senses.definitionCN: 把应用中的数据保存成外部格式的程序或功能
senses.example: The exporter writes the results to a plain text file.
senses.exampleCN: 导出程序把结果写进一个纯文本文件。
senses.why: Software names the routine as if it were a party, so the tool that sends data out is an exporter.
senses.whyCN: 软件把这个程序当作一方来命名，于是把数据送出去的工具就叫 exporter。

senses.title: A body that spreads cultural practices
senses.titleCN: 向外传播文化做法的人或机构
senses.definition: a person or institution that carries its own practices or ideas to other places
senses.definitionCN: 把自身做法或观念带到别处的个人或机构
senses.example: The conservatory became an exporter of a distinctive teaching style.
senses.exampleCN: 这所音乐学院成了一种独特教学风格的传播者。
senses.why: The outward motion survives without money: influence, too, can be shipped.
senses.whyCN: 向外动作不需要金钱也能成立：影响力同样可以被「运出去」。

senses.title: A producer of one commodity for foreign sale
senses.titleCN: 为外销生产某一商品的生产方
senses.definition: a farm, mine or producer that supplies a single commodity to foreign markets
senses.definitionCN: 向外国市场供应单一商品的农场、矿山或生产者
senses.example: The region is the world's largest exporter of lentils.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区是世界上最大的扁豆出口方。
senses.why: Commodity chains need a named origin, so the producer at the head of the chain is called the exporter.
senses.whyCN: 商品链需要一个具名的源头，于是链条最前端的生产者被称为出口方。

senses.title: The selling side of a trade contract
senses.titleCN: 贸易合同中的卖方一方
senses.definition: the party in a sales contract that sells and delivers the goods
senses.definitionCN: 买卖合同中出售并交付货物的一方
senses.example: The exporter covers insurance under the agreed terms.
senses.exampleCN: 按约定条款，出口方负责投保。
senses.why: Contracts prefer role names, so exporter serves as shorthand for the seller who ships.
senses.whyCN: 合同偏好角色名称，因此 exporter 成为「负责发运的卖方」的简称。

intro.en: Exporter is export plus the English agent suffix -er, so it names the doer of an outward carrying. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: exporter 是 export 加英语施动后缀 -er 构成，为「向外搬运」这一动作的执行者命名。年代均为约数。

items.en: Exportare 'to carry out' supplied the verb, built on ex- 'out' and portare 'to carry'.
items.cn: exportare「搬出去」提供动词，由 ex-「向外」与 portare「搬运」构成。

items.en: The suffix -er descends from Old English -ere and is the native means of naming a doer.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 源自古英语 -ere，是英语本族为执行者命名的手段。

items.en: As export settled into trade, exporter named the merchant who sold and shipped to foreign buyers.
items.cn: 随着 export 在贸易中固定下来，exporter 指向外国买方销售并发运的商人。

items.en: Customs law created the party of record, while trade statistics applied the word to whole economies.
items.cn: 海关法确立登记方，贸易统计则把这个词用到整个经济体上。

items.en: Software later borrowed the word for routines that write data out of an application.
items.cn: 软件随后借用这个词，指把数据写出应用程序的程序。

note.en: The first group shares the outward carrying stem or looks close to it; the second group names parties that also sell or ship.
note.cn: 第一组共享「向外搬运」词干或与之外形相近；第二组是同样销售或发运的一方。

entries.definition: The act of sending goods out; only the suffix turns it into a party.
entries.definitionCN: 把货物送出的动作；只有加上后缀才成为一方。

entries.definition: The procedure of exporting; it names the flow, while exporter names who causes it.
entries.definitionCN: 出口的程序；它指流动，而 exporter 指促成流动的人。

entries.definition: The same suffix on the opposite prefix: the party that buys and receives from abroad.
entries.definitionCN: 同一后缀加相反前缀：从境外买入并接收货物的一方。

entries.definition: A harbour, from Latin portus, not from portare; an exporter may use a port, but the words are unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 港口，出自拉丁 portus，并非 portare；出口商可能用港口，但两个词并无同源关系。

entries.definition: Anyone who sells; exporter adds that the buyer is abroad and the goods must leave the country.
entries.definitionCN: 任何卖方；exporter 额外说明买方在境外、货物必须离境。

entries.definition: A firm that provides goods to buyers; it may sell at home, while an exporter sells across a border.
entries.definitionCN: 向买方提供货物的公司；它可以在国内销售，而出口商跨越国界销售。

entries.definition: The party that arranges or performs the carriage; an exporter may also be the shipper, but the roles are distinct.
entries.definitionCN: 安排或执行运输的一方；出口商可能同时是发货人，但两个角色不同。

entries.definition: The selling party in a transaction or contract; exporter is the trade-specific narrowing of that role.
entries.definitionCN: 交易或合同中的卖方；exporter 是这一角色在贸易中的具体化。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real verb, the real suffix and real trade roles.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的动词、真实的后缀与真实贸易角色。

normal.en: Export plus -er: the party that carries goods out.
normal.cn: export 加 -er：把货物搬出去的那一方。

normal.en: The suffix marks a doer, so exporter can sign, invoice and be audited.
normal.cn: 后缀标出执行者，因此出口商能签字、开票、被审计。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the roles: net exporter, major exporter, exporter of record.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出角色：净出口方、主要出口商、报关出口方。

normal.en: The counterpart is importer, the same suffix on the opposite prefix.
normal.cn: 对应词是 importer，同一后缀加在相反的前缀上。

normal.en: An exporter sells outward; the goods, not the money, does the travelling.
normal.cn: 出口商向外销售；出行的是货物，不是钱。

abstract.en: Picture one signature at the end of a pier that sends a whole shipment on its way.
abstract.cn: 想象码头尽头一个签名，就把整票货物送上了路。

abstract.en: Picture a country drawn as a seller standing at the border with a full cart.
abstract.cn: 想象一个国家被画成站在边境、推着满车货物的卖方。

abstract.en: Picture a program packing its records into a box and pushing it out the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一个程序把记录装进箱子，推出门外。

examples.en: The exporter shipped the order two weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 出口商比计划提前两周发出了订单。

examples.en: Brazil is a major exporter of soybeans.
examples.cn: 巴西是大豆的主要出口国。

examples.en: The exporter of record must retain the shipping documents.
examples.cn: 报关出口方必须保存运输单据。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往外搬的人」——export 是搬出去，加个表示人的尾巴，就是负责卖到境外的那一方 → 出口商

root: export「出口」+ -er（英语本族施动后缀，源自古英语 -ere），指执行出口的人、公司或国家；同根动词出自拉丁 exportare。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name a party: a trading firm, a national economy, a customs debtor, an energy seller, a software routine, a cultural carrier, a commodity producer and the selling side of a contract.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项指的都是某一方：贸易公司、国家经济、海关义务人、能源卖方、软件程序、文化传播者、商品生产者，以及合同中的卖方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one merchant at a pier handing a bill of lading to a captain.
core.cn: 核心意象：码头边一位商人把提单递给船长。

branches.en: BASE DOER: the suffix turns carrying out into a business role.
branches.cn: 基础施动者：后缀把「搬出去」变成商业角色。

branches.en: WHOLE ECONOMIES: a country or grid acts as one seller.
branches.cn: 整体经济：国家或电网被当作单一卖方。

branches.en: LEGAL PARTY: customs and contracts need one named seller to carry liability.
branches.cn: 法律一方：海关与合同都需要一个具名卖方来承担责任。

branches.en: SYSTEM OUTPUT: software names its writing routine as a doer.
branches.cn: 系统出口：软件把写数据的程序也称作施动者。

branches.en: BEYOND GOODS: ideas and single commodities are sent out by the same kind of party.
branches.cn: 货物之外：观念与单一商品也由同类一方送出。

intro.en: Exporter combines a Latin verb of outward carrying with the native English suffix for doers.
intro.cn: exporter 把拉丁语表示向外搬运的动词，与英语本族的施动后缀组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' supplies the stem and gives export, import, transport and portable; the agent suffix is English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」提供词干，并衍生 export、import、transport 与 portable；施动后缀则来自英语。

items.example: They export wool to two markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把羊毛出口到两个市场。

items.example: The suffix turns actions into parties.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成一方。

items.example: The exporter booked the freight.
items.exampleCN: 出口商订好了舱位。

items.example: Exporters protested the new levy.
items.exampleCN: 出口商们抗议这项新税。

items.example: Exportation of scrap was banned.
items.exampleCN: 废料出口被禁止。

items.meaning: allowed or able to be exported
items.example: The fruit is exportable after inspection.
items.exampleCN: 水果经检验后可出口。

items.example: The importer cleared the goods.
items.exampleCN: 进口商办理了货物进境手续。

items.example: The porter carried the sacks.
items.exampleCN: 搬运工扛走了麻袋。

items.example: A portable scale was used.
items.exampleCN: 用了一台便携秤。

items.example: Ships transport the ore.
items.exampleCN: 船舶运输矿石。

definition_zh: 使暴露；揭露；使接触
definition_en: to leave something open to danger or influence; to reveal a truth; to give someone experience of something
core_image: 遮布被掀开，里面的东西露在光下
scene: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。 Do not expose your skin to the sun for long.
sceneCN: 这里 expose 是「使暴露于」（第 1 个义项）；句意：不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。

senses.title: Leave open to harm
senses.definition: to leave someone or something open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物处于危险、天气或影响之下
senses.example: The damaged roof exposed the room to rain.
senses.exampleCN: 损坏的屋顶让雨水淋进了房间。
senses.why: The core sense is removing cover or protection.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是去掉遮盖或保护。

senses.title: Reveal a truth
senses.definition: to make a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开
senses.example: The report exposed serious waste.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭露了严重的浪费。
senses.why: Physical uncovering becomes moral disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的揭开转为道德上的揭发。

senses.title: Give experience
senses.definition: to give someone experience of something new
senses.definitionCN: 让某人接触或体验新事物
senses.example: Travel exposes children to other cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行让孩子们接触其他文化。
senses.why: Being open to influence becomes learning.
senses.whyCN: 向影响敞开变成学习的过程。

intro.en: Expose comes from Latin exponere, to put out, from ex- out and ponere to place.
intro.cn: expose 来自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Ponere means to place.
items.cn: ponere 意为放置。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: Exposer carries the sense of setting out.
items.cn: 古法语 exposer 保留「摆出来」之义。

items.en: Expose means to uncover or reveal.
items.cn: 现代英语中 expose 意为使暴露或揭露。

note.en: Expose means uncover; oppose means stand against.
note.cn: expose 是揭开，oppose 则是反对。

entries.definition: to disagree with and try to stop
to think something is likely
to get rid of something
to make something known
to remove a cover or find a secret
to show something openly

normalIntro.en: Expose is about taking away cover, whether from skin or from a secret.
normalIntro.cn: expose 指去掉遮盖，无论是皮肤上的还是秘密上的。

normal.en: Do not expose the film to bright light.
normal.cn: 不要让胶片暴露在强光下。

normal.en: The newspaper exposed the false claims.
normal.cn: 报纸揭露了那些虚假说法。

normal.en: Workers were exposed to dangerous fumes.
normal.cn: 工人们接触到了危险气体。

normal.en: The scandal exposed weak controls.
normal.cn: 这起丑闻暴露出监管薄弱。

normal.en: Good teachers expose students to new ideas.
normal.cn: 好老师让学生接触新思想。

abstract.en: Picture a cloth pulled away from a hidden object.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布从隐藏的物体上被拉开。

abstract.en: Imagine a spotlight falling on a dark corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一束聚光灯照进黑暗的角落。

abstract.en: Think of a door opened to let fresh air in.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门打开，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: The report exposed waste in the department.
examples.cn: 报告揭露了该部门的浪费。

examples.en: Children should not be exposed to violence.
examples.cn: 不应让儿童接触暴力。

examples.en: The storm exposed the weakness of the roof.
examples.cn: 暴风雨暴露了屋顶的弱点。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 pose（放置）：把东西放到外面、不再遮住，就是 expose（暴露）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成，核心义「去掉遮盖，使显露」。

sensesIntro.en: Expose means to leave something unprotected, to reveal a truth, or to give someone new experience.
sensesIntro.cn: expose 意为使失去保护、揭露真相，或让某人获得新体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted off something hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：遮盖物被从隐藏之物上掀开。

branches.en: The base sense is opening to harm.
branches.cn: 基础义是向伤害敞开。

branches.en: Physical uncovering becomes public disclosure.
branches.cn: 物理上的揭开变成公开揭露。

branches.en: Being open to influence becomes learning.
branches.cn: 向影响敞开变成学习。

branches.en: A hidden fault can be exposed to view.
branches.cn: 隐藏的缺陷可以被暴露在眼前。

branches.en: Exposure to risk and exposure to new ideas share the same openness.
branches.cn: 暴露于风险与接触新思想都带有「敞开」之意。

intro.en: Expose belongs to the Latin ponere family, like expose and composition.
intro.cn: expose 属于拉丁语 ponere 词族，与 composition 等词同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere, ponere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere、ponere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.example: They exposed the faulty wiring.
items.exampleCN: 他们揭露了有问题的线路。

items.example: The test exposes weak spots.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试暴露出薄弱之处。

items.example: The exposed pipe froze in winter.
items.exampleCN: 暴露的管道冬天冻住了。

items.example: Exposing fraud takes courage.
items.exampleCN: 揭露欺诈需要勇气。

items.example: Exposure to cold can be dangerous.
items.exampleCN: 受寒可能很危险。

items.meaning: a full explanation or public show
items.example: The book begins with a short exposition.
items.exampleCN: 这本书以简短的阐述开篇。

items.example: The material is exposable to sunlight.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料可以暴露在阳光下。

items.example: Many residents oppose the plan.
items.exampleCN: 许多居民反对这个计划。

items.meaning: to place an idea before oneself
items.example: I suppose he will arrive soon.
items.exampleCN: 我想他很快就会到。

latinEntries.meaning: to put out or set forth

definition_zh: 阐述；解释；博览会；展览会；呈示部；说明性叙述
definition_en: a careful explanation of an idea, a large public show of goods or art, the first section of a piece of music that states its themes, or the background part of a story
core_image: 把一整箱东西倒在桌面上，逐件拿起来讲给人听
scene: 展厅的灯亮起来，讲解员把壁画的故事从头讲到了尾。When the hall lights came on, the guide gave a careful exposition of the mural.
sceneCN: 这里 exposition 是「阐述」（第 1 个义项：把一个想法或一件作品讲清楚）；句意：展厅的灯亮起来，讲解员把壁画的故事从头讲到了尾。

pos.zh: 阐述；解释；博览会；展览会；呈示部；说明性叙述

derivatives.zh: exposit 加形容词后缀 -ory 构成，义为「说明性的；解释性的」
拉丁语 expositor 直接进入英语，义为「讲解者；注释者」
同族动词，义为「使暴露；揭露」，是这一词族动作义的基础形式

senses.title: A detailed explanation
senses.definition: a full and careful explanation of an idea, theory, or text
senses.definitionCN: 对想法、理论或文本作出的完整而细致的解释
senses.example: Her exposition of the theory filled three pages.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这一理论的阐述写了整整三页。
senses.why: Latin exponere means to set something out, so an exposition places an idea where others can see it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 exponere 意为把东西摆出来，所以 exposition 就是把一个想法摆到别人看得见的地方。

senses.title: A public show of goods or art
senses.definition: a large public event at which goods, art, or machines are shown
senses.definitionCN: 公开展示商品、艺术品或机器的大型活动
senses.example: The world exposition drew millions of visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 这届世界博览会吸引了数百万参观者。
senses.why: The same setting out of things before the public turned into the name of a great hall of displays.
senses.whyCN: 同样是「把东西摆到公众面前」，后来变成了陈列大厅的名称。

senses.title: The opening section of a piece of music
senses.definition: the first part of a sonata or fugue, in which the main themes are stated
senses.definitionCN: 奏鸣曲或赋格的第一部分，主题在其中被陈述出来
senses.example: The exposition states the theme twice before the development.
senses.exampleCN: 呈示部在发展部之前把主题陈述了两遍。
senses.why: Music borrows the word because the composer sets out the themes first, just as a speaker sets out arguments.
senses.whyCN: 音乐借用这个词，因为作曲家先把主题摆出来，正如演讲者先摆出论点。

senses.title: Background material in a story
senses.definition: the part of a story or film that supplies background information before the action
senses.definitionCN: 故事或影片在情节展开之前提供背景信息的部分
senses.example: The novel opens with a long exposition of the family history.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说以一段冗长的家族史说明性叙述开篇。
senses.why: Readers also need facts set out for them, so the explaining sense moved into narrative description.
senses.whyCN: 读者同样需要有人把事实摆出来，于是「解释」这一义项进入了叙事描写的领域。

intro.en: Exposition comes from Latin expositio, a setting forth, from exponere, to put out or explain, built on ex- out and ponere to place.
intro.cn: exposition 来自拉丁语 expositio（摆出、陈述），源于 exponere（摆出去、说明），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or to set forth in words.
items.cn: exponere 意为摆出去，或用言语陈述出来。

items.en: Expositio names the act of setting something before an audience.
items.cn: expositio 指把某物摆到听众面前这一行为。

items.en: Old French exposicion carries the explaining sense.
items.cn: 古法语 exposicion 保留了「解释」的含义。

items.en: English exposition first names a written explanation.
items.cn: 英语 exposition 最初指书面的解释。

items.en: Modern English adds the exhibition sense and, later, the musical sense.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「展览会」义项，后来又增加了音乐义项。

note.en: Exposition is the noun of setting out an idea, and its family includes expose, exposure, and expository.
note.cn: exposition 是「把想法摆出来」的名词，同族词包括 expose、exposure 与 expository。

entries.definition: to lay something open to view
the state of being laid open
written or spoken to explain something
the act of making something clear
a public show of art or objects
the act of showing or explaining something to an audience

normalIntro.en: Exposition is a placing word: something is set out in words, in a hall, or in music.
normalIntro.cn: exposition 是「摆放」词：东西被摆进话里、摆进大厅、也摆进音乐。

normal.en: The Latin source exponere means to put out or set forth.
normal.cn: 拉丁语来源 exponere 意为摆出去、陈述出来。

normal.en: Exposition and expose share the same Latin base, so both point to laying something open.
normal.cn: exposition 与 expose 共享同一拉丁语基础，两者都指向「把东西摊开」。

normal.en: A trade exposition is a hall where goods are set out.
normal.cn: 「trade exposition」就是货品被摆出来陈列的大厅。

normal.en: In music the exposition is where themes are set before the listener.
normal.cn: 音乐里，exposition 是把主题摆到听者面前的那一段。

normal.en: Compare explanation: explanation is neutral, while exposition suggests a full and ordered account.
normal.cn: 对比 explanation：explanation 语气中性，exposition 则暗示完整而有条理的铺陈。

abstract.en: Picture a lecturer unrolling a long scroll across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一位讲者把长长一卷纸在桌上铺开。

abstract.en: Picture a wide hall where every stand is open to view.
abstract.cn: 想象一座宽敞的大厅，每个展台都敞开着给人看。

abstract.en: Picture an orchestra playing the same melody twice at the start.
abstract.cn: 想象乐队在开头把同一段旋律奏了两遍。

examples.en: The first chapter is a careful exposition of the method.
examples.cn: 第一章是对这一方法的细致阐述。

examples.en: The city hosted a world exposition on clean energy.
examples.cn: 这座城市举办了一届以清洁能源为主题的世界博览会。

examples.en: The exposition of the sonata lasts only four minutes.
examples.cn: 这首奏鸣曲的呈示部只有四分钟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ex 加 position——把东西放到外面（ex）的位置（position）上，就是摆出来给人看；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ ponere（放置）→ exponere（摆出来、说明）→ expositio（陈述）→ 古法语 exposicion → 英语 exposition，核心义「把东西摆出来讲给人听」。

sensesIntro.en: Exposition moves from setting out an idea in words to setting out goods in a hall, then themes in music, then background in a story.
sensesIntro.cn: exposition 先用话把想法摆出来，再在大厅里把货品摆出来，然后在音乐里摆出主题，最后在故事里摆出背景。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box tipped over on a table so every piece can be picked up and named.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只箱子在桌上倒空，每件东西都能被拿起、被叫出名字。

branches.en: Setting out an idea in words is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 用话把想法摆出来，是最早的义项。

branches.en: Setting out goods in a hall is the public sense.
branches.cn: 把货品摆进大厅，是面向公众的义项。

branches.en: Setting out themes is the musical sense.
branches.cn: 把主题摆出来，是音乐的义项。

branches.en: Setting out background is the narrative sense.
branches.cn: 把背景摆出来，是叙事的义项。

branches.en: A lecturer and an exhibition both place something before an audience.
branches.cn: 讲者与展览会都是把某样东西摆到观众面前。

intro.en: Exposition is built on Latin ex- and ponere, with expose, expository, and expositor in the same family.
intro.cn: exposition 建立在拉丁语 ex- 与 ponere 之上，同族词有 expose、expository 与 expositor。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere means to set forth, and expositio means a setting forth.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere 意为摆出来，expositio 意为摆出、陈述。

items.example: The prefix ex- carries the idea of outward movement.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 带有向外移动的意思。

items.example: Ponere supplies the placing image.
items.exampleCN: ponere 提供「放置」这一意象。

items.meaning: to put out, to set forth
items.example: Exponere is the direct parent of the word.
items.exampleCN: exponere 是这个词的直接来源。

items.example: Expositio is the noun of the same act.
items.exampleCN: expositio 是同一动作的名词形式。

items.example: Expositor names the person who explains.
items.exampleCN: expositor 指进行讲解的人。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ition forms nouns of action.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ition 构成表示动作的名词。

items.example: Expose keeps the laying open image.
items.exampleCN: expose 保留了「摊开」的意象。

items.example: Exposition keeps the noun sense.
items.exampleCN: exposition 保留名词含义。

items.example: Expository describes writing that explains.
items.exampleCN: expository 描述以解释为目的的文字。

definition_zh: 暴露；曝光；揭露；接触
definition_en: the state of being unprotected; public attention in the media; the act of revealing a secret; experience of something
core_image: 一块遮布被掀开后，物体完全显露在众人眼前
scene: 长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。 Long exposure to noise can damage hearing.
sceneCN: 这里 exposure 是「暴露、接触」（第 1 个义项）；句意：长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。

senses.title: Being unprotected
senses.definition: the state of being left open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 处于危险、天气或影响之下的状态
senses.example: Exposure to cold can make you ill.
senses.exampleCN: 受寒可能让你生病。
senses.why: The core sense is openness to harm.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是向伤害敞开。

senses.title: Public attention
senses.definition: attention given by newspapers, television, or the internet
senses.definitionCN: 报纸、电视或网络给予的关注
senses.example: The film gained wide media exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影获得了广泛的媒体曝光。
senses.why: Being seen by many becomes public attention.
senses.whyCN: 被许多人看见转为公众关注。

senses.title: Revealing a secret
senses.definition: the act of making a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开的行为
senses.example: The exposure of the fraud shocked investors.
senses.exampleCN: 骗局被揭露令投资者震惊。
senses.why: Uncovering becomes an act of disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 揭开变成公开披露的行为。

senses.title: Photographic exposure
senses.definition: the amount of light allowed to reach film or a sensor
senses.definitionCN: 允许到达胶片或传感器的光量
senses.example: The photo failed because of over exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片因曝光过度而失败。
senses.why: Openness to light becomes a technical term.
senses.whyCN: 向光敞开变成摄影术语。

intro.en: Exposure comes from expose plus the noun ending -ure, from Latin exponere.
intro.cn: exposure 由 expose 加名词词尾 -ure 构成，根源是拉丁语 exponere。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: The ending -ura forms nouns of action or state.
items.cn: 词尾 -ura 构成表示动作或状态的名词。

items.en: Exposure develops the sense of being laid open.
items.cn: exposure 发展出「被敞开」的含义。

items.en: Exposure names the state of being unprotected.
items.cn: exposure 指未受保护的状态。

items.en: Exposure covers media attention and photography.
items.cn: 现代英语中 exposure 涵盖媒体关注与摄影。

note.en: Exposure is being seen or uncovered; enclosure is being shut in.
note.cn: exposure 是被看见或揭开，enclosure 则是被围起来。

entries.definition: an area shut off by a fence
the act of leaving
a feeling of enjoyment
a surprising fact made known
the act of making something public
the state of touching or meeting

normalIntro.en: Exposure is the noun form of expose, naming the state or act of being uncovered.
normalIntro.cn: exposure 是 expose 的名词形式，表示被揭开的状态或行为。

normal.en: Long exposure to sun can damage the skin.
normal.cn: 长时间日晒会损伤皮肤。

normal.en: The singer enjoys great exposure online.
normal.cn: 这位歌手在网上享有很高的曝光度。

normal.en: The exposure of the secret changed everything.
normal.cn: 秘密被揭露后，一切都变了。

normal.en: The camera needs a longer exposure at night.
normal.cn: 夜里拍摄需要更长的曝光时间。

normal.en: Workers demanded protection from chemical exposure.
normal.cn: 工人们要求防止化学品暴露。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight sweeping over a hidden stage.
abstract.cn: 想象聚光灯扫过一个隐藏的舞台。

abstract.en: Imagine a sealed letter suddenly opened in public.
abstract.cn: 想象一封密封的信在众人面前突然被打开。

abstract.en: Think of a lens letting light fall on film.
abstract.cn: 想象镜头让光落在胶片上。

examples.en: The study measured exposure to pollution.
examples.cn: 这项研究测量了污染暴露程度。

examples.en: The scandal brought the company unwanted exposure.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻让公司得到了不想要的曝光。

examples.en: The exposure of the evidence led to a trial.
examples.cn: 证据被揭露后引发了审判。

dict_mnemonic.text: expose 加名词后缀 -ure，表示「被暴露的状态」，就是 exposure。

root: 由 expose 加 -ure 构成，根源是拉丁语 exponere（放出去），核心义「被敞开、显露的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Exposure means being unprotected, public attention, the act of revealing, or photographic light.
sensesIntro.cn: exposure 意为处于无保护状态、公众关注、揭露行为，或摄影曝光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an uncovered object seen by many eyes.
core.cn: 核心意象：被众人看见的暴露之物。

branches.en: The base sense is the state of being unprotected.
branches.cn: 基础义是未受保护的状态。

branches.en: Being seen becomes media attention.
branches.cn: 被看见变成媒体关注。

branches.en: Uncovering becomes public disclosure.
branches.cn: 揭开变成公开披露。

branches.en: Openness to light becomes a camera term.
branches.cn: 向光敞开变成摄影术语。

branches.en: Public attention and disclosure often come together.
branches.cn: 公众关注与揭露常常相伴。

intro.en: Exposure is expose plus -ure, a Latin noun ending seen in enclosure and departure.
intro.cn: exposure 由 expose 加 -ure 构成，-ure 是见于 enclosure、departure 的拉丁名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere and the noun ending -ura lie behind exposure.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere 与名词词尾 -ura 是 exposure 的来源。

items.example: Exposure to light spoiled the film.
items.exampleCN: 曝光让胶片坏了。

items.meaning: several acts or cases of exposure
items.example: The study recorded daily exposures.
items.exampleCN: 研究记录了每日的暴露次数。

items.example: Do not expose the sample to air.
items.exampleCN: 不要让样品接触空气。

items.example: The exposed wire is dangerous.
items.exampleCN: 裸露的电线很危险。

items.example: Exposing a lie is not always easy.
items.exampleCN: 揭穿谎言并不总是容易。

items.example: The essay opens with an exposition.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章以一段阐述开篇。

items.example: The chemical is exposable to heat.
items.exampleCN: 这种化学品可以暴露在高温下。

items.example: Overexposure made the picture white.
items.exampleCN: 过度曝光让照片发白。

items.example: Underexposure left the photo dark.
items.exampleCN: 曝光不足让照片很暗。

latinEntries.meaning: to put out or set forth

definition_zh: 详细阐述；详细解释；讲解（经文）
definition_en: to explain a theory, belief, or text in detail and at length
core_image: 一本厚书被摊平打开，讲者用手指一行行点过去
scene: 老师傅把祖传的配方摊在桌上，一层层讲清每味料的来由。The old master expounded the recipe, explaining where each ingredient came from.
sceneCN: 这里 expound 是「详细阐述」（第 1 个义项：系统而详尽地讲解理论或做法）；句意：老师傅把祖传的配方摊在桌上，一层层讲清每味料的来由。

pos.zh: 详细阐述；详细解释；讲解（经文）
（与 on 连用）详述；长篇论述

derivatives.zh: expound 加表示人的后缀 -er 构成，义为「阐述者；讲解者」
同一拉丁语来源的名词形式，义为「阐述；博览会」，动作义与 expound 相应
由同一来源加后缀 -ory 构成，义为「说明性的；解释性的」

senses.title: To explain a theory in detail
senses.definition: to set out a theory, belief, or system in full detail
senses.definitionCN: 把理论、信念或体系完整而详尽地讲出来
senses.example: He expounded his views on education for a full hour.
senses.exampleCN: 他用整整一个小时详细阐述自己对教育的看法。
senses.why: Latin exponere means to set a thing out, so expound keeps the picture of laying an argument open piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 exponere 意为把东西摆出来，所以 expound 保留了「把论点一块块摊开」的画面。

senses.title: To explain a sacred text
senses.definition: to interpret and explain a text, especially a religious one
senses.definitionCN: 解释并说明一段文本，尤指宗教文本
senses.example: The elder expounded the passage to the gathered families.
senses.exampleCN: 长者向聚在一起的各家讲解了那一段经文。
senses.why: The same Latin verb was used for explaining texts, so expound long kept the sense of interpreting scripture.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁语动词也用于解释文本，因此 expound 长期保留「解读经文」这一义项。

senses.title: To speak at length on a subject
senses.definition: to talk or write about a subject at length, often in a formal setting
senses.definitionCN: 就一个题目长篇地谈或写，常见于正式场合
senses.example: She expounded on the need for better rural schools.
senses.exampleCN: 她详细论述了改善乡村学校的必要性。
senses.why: Setting out a case before listeners turned into speaking at length on any subject.
senses.whyCN: 在听众面前把理由摆出来，后来就泛指就任何题目长篇地讲。

intro.en: Expound comes from Old French espondre, from Latin exponere, to set forth, the same source as exposition.
intro.cn: expound 来自古法语 espondre，源于拉丁语 exponere（摆出来、陈述），与 exposition 同源。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or to explain in words.
items.cn: exponere 意为摆出去，或用言语解释清楚。

items.en: Expositum is the supine form of exponere and supplies the stem seen in related nouns.
items.cn: expositum 是 exponere 的动名词形式，为相关名词提供了词干。

items.en: Espondre means to explain or interpret.
items.cn: 古法语 espondre 意为解释、诠释。

items.en: Expounen appears as a verb meaning to set out a meaning.
items.cn: 中古英语 expounen 作为动词出现，意为把含义讲出来。

items.en: Modern English settles the spelling as expound and keeps the formal tone.
items.cn: 现代英语把拼写固定为 expound，并保留了正式的语体色彩。

note.en: Expound shares the Latin base exponere with exposition and expository, and sits near plain explaining verbs.
note.cn: expound 与 exposition、expository 共享拉丁语基础 exponere，并与朴素的「解释」类动词相邻。

entries.definition: a full explanation or a public show
serving to explain something
a person who sets out or explains an idea
to make something clear
to give more detail about something
to make something easier to understand

normalIntro.en: Expound is a setting-out verb: the speaker places an idea in front of listeners and takes it apart.
normalIntro.cn: expound 是「摆出来」的动词：讲者把想法摆到听者面前，再一层层拆开。

normal.en: Both expound and exposition come from Latin exponere, to set forth.
normal.cn: expound 与 exposition 都来自拉丁语 exponere（摆出来）。

normal.en: Expound is the verb of the pair and exposition is the noun.
normal.cn: 这一对词里 expound 是动词，exposition 是名词。

normal.en: Expound on is the usual pattern before a topic.
normal.cn: 「expound on」是接题目时的常见结构。

normal.en: The past tense is expounded, never expound.
normal.cn: 过去式是 expounded，不能写成 expound。

normal.en: Compare explain: explain is neutral, while expound suggests length and system.
normal.cn: 对比 explain：explain 中性，expound 则暗示篇幅长、成体系。

abstract.en: Picture a teacher filling a whole board with one theory.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老师用一整套黑板写满同一个理论。

abstract.en: Picture a reader opening an old book, reading a line aloud, then unpacking it.
abstract.cn: 想象读者打开一本旧书，念出一行，再把它拆开讲。

abstract.en: Picture a speaker standing up and laying out a plan point by point.
abstract.cn: 想象一位讲者站起来，把计划一点一点摆出来。

examples.en: The professor expounded the theory of tides in two lectures.
examples.cn: 教授用两堂课详细阐述了潮汐理论。

examples.en: Each Sunday the elder expounded a passage from the old letters.
examples.cn: 每个周日，长者都会讲解旧书信中的一段。

examples.en: She expounded on the value of small farms to the committee.
examples.cn: 她向委员会详细论述了小农场的价值。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ex 加 pound——把观点像磅秤上的砝码一样一块块称出来给人看，就是详细阐述；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ ponere（放置）→ exponere（摆出来、说明白）→ 古法语 espondre → 中古英语 expounen → 英语 expound，核心义「把想法摆出来讲清楚」。

sensesIntro.en: Expound keeps a formal tone: it can mean explaining a theory, interpreting a sacred text, or speaking at length on a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: expound 语体正式：既可指阐述理论，也可指讲解经文，还可指就某个题目长篇论述。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick book held open while a listener follows each line with a finger.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本厚书被摊开举着，听者用手指一行行跟着看。

branches.en: Explaining a theory in full is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把理论完整讲清，是核心义项。

branches.en: Interpreting a text is the oldest written sense.
branches.cn: 解读文本，是最早的书面义项。

branches.en: Speaking at length on a subject is the spoken sense.
branches.cn: 就一个题目长篇地讲，是口语场合的义项。

branches.en: A theory and a sacred text are both set out line by line.
branches.cn: 理论与经文都是被一行一行摆出来讲的。

branches.en: A written account and a long speech both lay out an argument.
branches.cn: 书面陈述与长篇演讲都是把一个论点铺开来。

intro.en: Expound is built on Latin ex- and ponere, with exposition, expository, and expounder beside it.
intro.cn: expound 建立在拉丁语 ex- 与 ponere 之上，旁边有 exposition、expository 与 expounder。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere means to set forth, and its noun expositio means a setting forth.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere 意为摆出来，其名词 expositio 意为摆出、陈述。

items.example: The prefix ex- points the action outward.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 把动作指向外面。

items.example: Ponere supplies the placing image.
items.exampleCN: ponere 提供「放置」这一意象。

items.example: Exponere is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: exponere 是这一整族词的来源。

items.example: Espondre carries the word into French.
items.exampleCN: espondre 把这个词带进了法语。

items.example: Expound keeps the formal written tone.
items.exampleCN: expound 保留了正式的书面语体。

items.example: Exposition is the noun of the same act.
items.exampleCN: exposition 是同一动作的名词。

items.example: Expository marks writing that explains.
items.exampleCN: expository 标记以解释为目的的文字。

items.example: The suffix -er forms expounder.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 expounder。

items.example: The suffix -er turns the act into a person.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 把动作变成做动作的人。

definition_zh: 表达；表示；快速的；快车
definition_en: to show thoughts or feelings; to send something quickly; fast and direct; a fast train or service
core_image: 把心里的想法像挤牙膏一样压出来，让对方看见
scene: 她很难表达自己的感受。 She found it hard to express her feelings.
sceneCN: 这里 express 是「表达、表示」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她很难表达自己的感受。

senses.title: Show thoughts
senses.definition: to show thoughts, feelings, or ideas in words or actions
senses.definitionCN: 用语言或行动表现思想、感情或想法
senses.example: He expressed his thanks with a letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他写信表达了自己的感谢。
senses.why: The core sense is pressing something out into view.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把内心的东西压出来让人看见。

senses.title: Send quickly
senses.definition: to send something by a fast service
senses.definitionCN: 通过快速服务寄送某物
senses.example: Please express the parcel to London.
senses.exampleCN: 请把包裹快递到伦敦。
senses.why: Pressing out becomes pressing forward in speed.
senses.whyCN: 「压出」转为速度上的「快速送达」。

senses.title: Fast and direct
senses.definition: fast, direct, and making few stops
senses.definitionCN: 快速、直达且停站很少的
senses.example: We took the express train to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们乘特快列车去了海边。
senses.why: The idea of direct movement becomes a travel word.
senses.whyCN: 直达移动的概念变成交通用语。

senses.title: A fast service
senses.definition: a fast train or a quick delivery service
senses.definitionCN: 快速列车或快速递送服务
senses.example: The express leaves at seven.
senses.exampleCN: 快车七点出发。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a noun for the service.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为表示该服务的名词。

intro.en: Express comes from Latin exprimere, to press out, from ex- out and premere to press.
intro.cn: express 来自拉丁语 exprimere（压出来），由 ex-（向外）与 premere（压）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Premere means to press.
items.cn: premere 意为压。

items.en: Exprimere means to press out.
items.cn: exprimere 意为压出来。

items.en: Express keeps the sense of making clear.
items.cn: 古法语中 express 保留「使清楚」之义。

items.en: Express also means fast and direct.
items.cn: 现代英语中 express 也表示快速直达。

note.en: Express means press out; impress means press in.
note.cn: express 是压出来，impress 则是压进去、留下印象。

entries.definition: to make someone admire you
to press something into less space
to stop something by force
to communicate an idea or feeling
to say something clearly
to say what you think

normalIntro.en: Express moves from pressing feelings out to sending things fast.
normalIntro.cn: express 从「把感情压出来」发展到「快速寄送」。

normal.en: She expressed her thanks in a short speech.
normal.cn: 她用简短的讲话表达了感谢。

normal.en: The letter was expressed to New York.
normal.cn: 这封信被快递到纽约。

normal.en: They took the express to the capital.
normal.cn: 他们乘快车去了首都。

normal.en: Art allows people to express strong feelings.
normal.cn: 艺术让人们表达强烈的情感。

normal.en: The express service costs a little more.
normal.cn: 快递服务费用稍高一些。

abstract.en: Picture words being squeezed out of a full heart.
abstract.cn: 想象话语从满怀情感的心里被挤出来。

abstract.en: Imagine a train passing every small station.
abstract.cn: 想象一列火车掠过每个小站。

abstract.en: Think of a letter racing across the map.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信在地图上飞驰。

examples.en: He could not express his anger in words.
examples.cn: 他无法用语言表达自己的愤怒。

examples.en: The package was expressed overnight.
examples.cn: 包裹连夜快递出去了。

examples.en: The express stops only at major cities.
examples.cn: 这趟快车只在大城市停靠。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 press（压）：把心里的想法压出来，就是 express（表达）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exprimere（压出来），由 ex-（向外）与 premere（压）构成，核心义「把内在之物压出、送达」。

sensesIntro.en: Express means to show thoughts, to send quickly, to be fast and direct, or a fast service.
sensesIntro.cn: express 意为表达思想、快速寄送、快速直达，或快车服务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: words pressed out into the open.
core.cn: 核心意象：话语被压出来、显露于外。

branches.en: The base sense is pressing thoughts into view.
branches.cn: 基础义是把思想压出来让人看见。

branches.en: Pressing out becomes sending quickly.
branches.cn: 「压出」变成「快速寄送」。

branches.en: Speed and directness become travel qualities.
branches.cn: 速度与直达变成交通特征。

branches.en: The adjective becomes a noun for the service.
branches.cn: 形容词转为表示该服务的名词。

branches.en: Fast sending and fast service share the same speed.
branches.cn: 快速寄送与快速服务共享同一种速度。

intro.en: Express belongs to the Latin premere family, like compress and impress.
intro.cn: express 属于拉丁语 premere 词族，与 compress、impress 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exprimere, premere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exprimere、premere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.example: She expressed her thanks.
items.exampleCN: 她表达了感谢。

items.example: The poem expresses deep grief.
items.exampleCN: 这首诗表达了深深的悲痛。

items.example: He expressed his view calmly.
items.exampleCN: 他平静地表达了自己的看法。

items.example: She wrote a letter expressing thanks.
items.exampleCN: 她写了一封表示感谢的信。

items.meaning: the act of showing or a look on the face
items.example: His expression changed at once.
items.exampleCN: 他的表情立刻变了。

items.example: She has a very expressive face.
items.exampleCN: 她有一张很富表现力的脸。

items.example: The rule expressly forbids smoking.
items.exampleCN: 规定明确禁止吸烟。

items.meaning: to press in and leave a strong effect
items.example: The speech impressed the audience.
items.exampleCN: 演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。

items.example: They compress the data into a small file.
items.exampleCN: 他们把数据压缩成一个小文件。
